propositions: A single mapped project's transport failure (HTTP 400/401/403/404/429/5xx/timeout) in base-query loop currently aborts the entire reconciler pass for all projects.
Base-query loop lacks per-project error isolation that already exists in the enrichment loop (_enrich_project fails open independently).
Per-project fetch failures must be caught, emit a fetcher-project-fetch-failed alert with project key and pass_id, and continue processing remaining projects.
Partial/incomplete reads from a failed project must never be merged into the shared snapshot to prevent false deletion signals.
Invalid/absent project keys must still fail closed and abort the pass (preserving bug 626d intent); only transport errors should fail open.
BackendPaginationStallError must re-raise (stalled pager is a truncated whole-project read requiring loud failure).
